description: Under late-elision, the reading that reads on beats the one that elides a terminator earlier. Through x, KU is elided at 1; through y, B is read there and KU is elided at 2. Lazy would close x first and choose it (engine §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%elidable KU
%rule text x B | y
%rule x A [KU]
%rule y A B [KU]
